decisions.reason: Automatically clearing in-field text on activation does not change the label text, its relationship to the initial prompt, or its continued availability on hover.
The source changes placeholder behavior after activation, not the visual cue used to identify fillable fields.
Clearing in-field text on activation does not alter the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The source adds an independently represented activation behavior and does not replace or otherwise change the requirement to use a robust placeholder mechanism.
The source does not change the selected checklist control type or establish that a checklist contains removable placeholder text.
The source does not change the dropdown control type or its Bestyrelsesmode context.
Automatically clearing text in a control field does not change the calendar-style date input method.
The source concerns interactive-field text behavior and has no effect on required theme colors.
Placeholder clearing on field activation does not change automatic bullet creation when Enter is pressed.
The source does not change legacy-content migration, copy-paste stability, or the migration workflow.
The source changes in-field text interaction and does not affect bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, or appearance.
Clearing placeholder text on activation does not change manual line-break behavior after pasting legacy content.
